description: Source code for security context and key management in a wireless communication system, including algorithm selection, key generation, and key derivation functions.

classes.name: security_context
classes.description: Class managing security algorithms, key generation, and key derivation for a communication session.

methods.name: select_algorithms
methods.description: Selects preferred integrity and ciphering algorithms based on supported options and preferences.

methods.name: generate_as_keys
methods.description: Generates security keys for RRC and user plane encryption and integrity.

methods.name: horizontal_key_derivation
methods.description: Derives new security keys based on PCI and SSB-ARFCN, updating the current key.

methods.name: get_128_as_config
methods.description: Returns a truncated 128-bit security configuration for a specified domain.

methods.name: get_as_config
methods.description: Returns the security configuration for a specified domain.
